paragraphs.source_en: Sanada Yukimura's plan ultimately came to nothing. On the twenty-second and twenty-third days of the twelfth month in the nineteenth year of Keichō, written oaths were exchanged and acknowledged by both sides, bringing the peace negotiations to a successful conclusion.

units.source_en: Sanada Yukimura's plan ultimately came to nothing.

paragraphs.source_en: On the twenty-fourth, as an expression of gratitude, Oda Urakusai and Ōno Harunaga each presented Tokugawa Ieyasu with ceremonial robes. At the same time, Urakusai's son Nagamasa and Harunaga's son Harunori accompanied the envoys and were handed over as hostages.

units.source_en: On the twenty-fourth, as an expression of gratitude, Oda Urakusai and Ōno Harunaga each presented Tokugawa Ieyasu with ceremonial robes.

paragraphs.source_en: No one rejoiced more at the coming of peace than Lady Yodo, who also sent Ieyasu a set of soft, downy cotton bedding. Perhaps she had considered Ieyasu's advanced age and frailty, as well as the bitter cold in camp. The gift was filled with a woman's warm solicitude, yet it also provoked considerable gossip among the older women.

paragraphs.source_en: A woman gave bedding to a man only upon marriage, and the gift also carried an implication that she wished to share his bed. Naturally, the women could not help gossiping about what such a gift to Ieyasu at this particular time was supposed to mean. Lady Yodo, however, knew nothing of such insinuations. She merely felt that bedding was the most fitting gift through which to convey her heartfelt goodwill to Ieyasu.

paragraphs.source_en: Of course, it was not only the women who rejoiced over the peace accord. Letters had been sent one by one to the former Toyotomi retainers, but there was now no need to await their replies. The veteran commanders of the Seven Units were therefore even more delighted than the women. Under the pretext of presenting celebrated swords and their provenance records, the seven commanders made their way one after another to Ieyasu's headquarters to offer their congratulations.

paragraphs.source_en: “This is indeed cause for celebration.” After accepting their congratulations, Ieyasu narrowed his eyes and said, “Now that swords have been beaten into ploughshares, let us speak no more of the past. I trust that all of you will remain forever loyal to Lord Ufu.”

paragraphs.source_en: That day, Ieyasu relieved Ii Naotaka of his duty guarding Fushimi Castle and ordered him back to Sawayama. He also commended Hachisuka Yoshishige and the others for their service in battle, and finally lifted the siege of Osaka Castle. The commanders were reminded once more of Ieyasu's power and happily began preparing to strike camp.

units.source_en: Day and night I rack my brains over how to ensure the shogunate's lasting prosperity. How could I begrudge a few words?”

paragraphs.source_zh: “那还用说？我日夜都在为如何让幕府久长而操心不已，怎会吝惜几句话呢？”

paragraphs.source_en: Thus the daimyos assembled at the main camp on Chausuyama, and after conferring together, they went as one to see Ieyasu.

units.source_en: Thus the daimyos assembled at the main camp on Chausuyama, and after conferring together, they went as one to see Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 就这样，众大名集结到了茶磨山的大营，经过商议，一起去见家康。

paragraphs.source_zh: 就这样，众大名集结到了茶磨山的大营，经过商议，一起去见家康。

paragraphs.source_en: Each man spoke more indignantly than the last, arguing that the peace accord had done nothing to resolve the most fundamental problem—the disorder caused by the rōnin—and that peace could not endure. Ieyasu listened silently to their opinions.

units.source_en: Each man spoke more indignantly than the last, arguing that the peace accord had done nothing to resolve the most fundamental problem—the disorder caused by the rōnin—and that peace could not endure.
units.source_zh: 众人一个比一个激愤，认为议和丝毫未解决浪人之乱这一最根本的问题，太平不会持续下去。

units.source_en: Ieyasu listened silently to their opinions.
units.source_zh: 家康默默倾听着众人的意见。

paragraphs.source_zh: 众人一个比一个激愤，认为议和丝毫未解决浪人之乱这一最根本的问题，太平不会持续下去。家康默默倾听着众人的意见。

paragraphs.source_en: “However magnanimous the retired shogun may be, they remain rebels in the end, and under no circumstances should they be granted any further fiefs. If they are not dealt with, today's turmoil will merely have been postponed until tomorrow.” The moment the young Matsudaira Tadaaki spoke, Date Masamune solemnly voiced his agreement.

units.source_en: “However magnanimous the retired shogun may be, they remain rebels in the end, and under no circumstances should they be granted any further fiefs.

ja.t: などしてはなりません。

units.source_zh: “大御所再宽宏大量，他们终究还是谋叛者，断然不可再为他们加封。

units.source_en: If they are not dealt with, today's turmoil will merely have been postponed until tomorrow.”
units.source_zh: 若不处置，无非把今日的骚动推迟到明日而已。”

units.source_en: The moment the young Matsudaira Tadaaki spoke, Date Masamune solemnly voiced his agreement.
units.source_zh: 年轻的松平忠明一开口，伊达政宗立刻庄重地附和。

paragraphs.source_zh: “大御所再宽宏大量，他们终究还是谋叛者，断然不可再为他们加封。若不处置，无非把今日的骚动推迟到明日而已。”年轻的松平忠明一开口，伊达政宗立刻庄重地附和。

paragraphs.source_en: Until then, Ieyasu had maintained a genial expression, but now his face abruptly hardened. “You are all fools!” He thundered angrily, “Those who commit injustice shall surely incur Heaven's wrath!”

units.source_en: Until then, Ieyasu had maintained a genial expression, but now his face abruptly hardened.

ja.t: にこやかだったが、そのとき

units.source_zh: 家康之前一直和颜悦色，此时却忽然翻了脸。

units.source_en: “You are all fools!”
units.source_zh: “诸位糊涂！”

units.source_en: He thundered angrily, “Those who commit injustice shall surely incur Heaven's wrath!”
units.source_zh: 他一声怒喝，“行不义者，必遭天谴！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康之前一直和颜悦色，此时却忽然翻了脸。“诸位糊涂！”他一声怒喝，“行不义者，必遭天谴！”

paragraphs.source_en: Startled, the men looked at one another. Of late, Ieyasu had rarely spoken with such vehemence.

units.source_en: Startled, the men looked at one another.
units.source_zh: 众人一惊，面面相觑。

units.source_en: Of late, Ieyasu had rarely spoken with such vehemence.

ja.t: することはめったになかった。

units.source_zh: 近来，家康已很少有如此激烈的言辞了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 众人一惊，面面相觑。近来，家康已很少有如此激烈的言辞了。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu did not look at Masamune. He glared at Masazumi and Tadanao, then turned his piercing gaze upon Tadao, Tadaaki, Toshitsune, and the other young men, breathing heavily.

units.source_en: Ieyasu did not look at Masamune.
units.source_zh: 家康并不看政宗。

units.source_en: He glared at Masazumi and Tadanao, then turned his piercing gaze upon Tadao, Tadaaki, Toshitsune, and the other young men, breathing heavily.
units.source_zh: 他瞪了一眼正纯、忠直，又把锐利的目光投向忠雄、忠明、利常等年轻人，呼呼喘着粗气。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康并不看政宗。他瞪了一眼正纯、忠直，又把锐利的目光投向忠雄、忠明、利常等年轻人，呼呼喘着粗气。

paragraphs.source_en: The young men all stood frozen, utterly absorbed in his words. Date Masamune also assumed an air of reverent admiration, but his thoughts differed from everyone else's. He too was deeply moved, yet his judgment remained colder: the old devil was truly brilliant! What a consummate old fox!

units.source_en: The young men all stood frozen, utterly absorbed in his words. Date Masamune also assumed an air of reverent admiration, but his thoughts differed from everyone else's.
units.source_zh: 年轻人全都僵在那里，听得入了神，伊达政宗虽也一副敬服的样子，想法却与别人不一样。

units.source_en: He too was deeply moved, yet his judgment remained colder: the old devil was truly brilliant!
units.source_zh: 他的确也感慨万千，却更是冷静：老东西实在高明！

units.source_en: What a consummate old fox!
units.source_zh: 实是老奸巨猾！

paragraphs.source_zh: 年轻人全都僵在那里，听得入了神，伊达政宗虽也一副敬服的样子，想法却与别人不一样。他的确也感慨万千，却更是冷静：老东西实在高明！实是老奸巨猾！

paragraphs.source_en: Someone cried out, “I understand!” When the others looked, they saw that it was Maeda Toshitsune.

units.source_en: Someone cried out, “I understand!” When the others looked, they saw that it was Maeda Toshitsune.
units.source_zh: 有人大呼“明白”，众人一看，乃是前田利常。

paragraphs.source_zh: 有人大呼“明白”，众人一看，乃是前田利常。

paragraphs.source_en: Masamune's heart sank once more. Together with his son, Tōtōmi-no-kami Hidemune, he had commanded ten thousand men in the defense of the Matsuyamachi entrance. Naturally, then, he wished to remain and see what became of Osaka. Once the other daimyos had returned to their domains, he, Date Masamune, could readily lead ten thousand troops into the castle; if there were any chance of victory, he might well gamble once more and incite the Christians to rise in revolt. But Ieyasu already seemed to have anticipated this and made meticulous arrangements.

units.source_en: Masamune's heart sank once more.
units.source_zh: 政宗心里又是一沉。

units.source_en: Together with his son, Tōtōmi-no-kami Hidemune, he had commanded ten thousand men in the defense of the Matsuyamachi entrance.
units.source_zh: 他和儿子远江守秀宗共率一万人在松屋町口固守。

units.source_en: Naturally, then, he wished to remain and see what became of Osaka.
units.source_zh: 因而，他自然想留下来看看大坂日后的情形。

units.source_en: Once the other daimyos had returned to their domains, he, Date Masamune, could readily lead ten thousand troops into the castle; if there were any chance of victory, he might well gamble once more and incite the Christians to rise in revolt.
units.source_zh: 他伊达政宗在诸大名返回本领之后，完全可以率领一万兵马入城，一旦有胜算，他极有可能再赌一把，鼓动洋教徒起事。

units.source_en: But Ieyasu already seemed to have anticipated this and made meticulous arrangements.
units.source_zh: 可是，家康对此似已有细心的算计和周密的安排。

paragraphs.source_zh: 政宗心里又是一沉。他和儿子远江守秀宗共率一万人在松屋町口固守。因而，他自然想留下来看看大坂日后的情形。他伊达政宗在诸大名返回本领之后，完全可以率领一万兵马入城，一旦有胜算，他极有可能再赌一把，鼓动洋教徒起事。可是，家康对此似已有细心的算计和周密的安排。

paragraphs.source_en: At Ieyasu's command, Honda Masazumi produced a paper prepared in advance, listing the laborers each daimyo was to furnish, and said, “The retired shogun will strike camp early tomorrow morning and return to Nijō Castle. This order was originally to be issued at Nijō Castle on the twenty-seventh, but since the matter has already arisen, I shall inform you of it here in advance.” With that, he began to read it aloud.

units.source_en: At Ieyasu's command, Honda Masazumi produced a paper prepared in advance, listing the laborers each daimyo was to furnish, and said, “The retired shogun will strike camp early tomorrow morning and return to Nijō Castle.
units.source_zh: 在家康的命令下，本多正纯把早已备好的写有各大名所出人夫的纸取出，道：“大御所大人明日一早就将拔营返回二条城。

units.source_en: This order was originally to be issued at Nijō Castle on the twenty-seventh, but since the matter has already arisen, I shall inform you of it here in advance.”
units.source_zh: 此令原定二十七日在二条城发布，既然已经论及，那就在此处先行内示。”

units.source_en: With that, he began to read it aloud.
units.source_zh: 说着宣读起来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在家康的命令下，本多正纯把早已备好的写有各大名所出人夫的纸取出，道：“大御所大人明日一早就将拔营返回二条城。此令原定二十七日在二条城发布，既然已经论及，那就在此处先行内示。”说着宣读起来。

paragraphs.source_en: As Masamune listened, his fighting spirit gradually ebbed away. At this point, all he could do was leave everyone with an impression of how loyally he served the shogunate, and then withdraw. Ieyasu's calculations were seamless, without the slightest flaw to exploit.

units.source_en: As Masamune listened, his fighting spirit gradually ebbed away.
units.source_zh: 听着听着，政宗的斗志逐渐消失。

units.source_en: At this point, all he could do was leave everyone with an impression of how loyally he served the shogunate, and then withdraw.
units.source_zh: 至此，他只能给众人留下一个他是何等忠诚地为幕府效力的印象，然后退下。

units.source_en: Ieyasu's calculations were seamless, without the slightest flaw to exploit.
units.source_zh: 家康的思虑天衣无缝，找不到丝毫纰漏。

paragraphs.source_zh: 听着听着，政宗的斗志逐渐消失。至此，他只能给众人留下一个他是何等忠诚地为幕府效力的印象，然后退下。家康的思虑天衣无缝，找不到丝毫纰漏。

paragraphs.source_en: Even so, people still held differing views about filling in the castle moats.

units.source_en: Even so, people still held differing views about filling in the castle moats.
units.source_zh: 尽管如此，世人还是对填埋护城河持有不同看法。

paragraphs.source_zh: 尽管如此，世人还是对填埋护城河持有不同看法。

paragraphs.source_en: The daimyos had only just ceased confronting Osaka, and their hearts remained filled with fierce hostility; a great many of them wanted to take part in the filling work. Then came the calculations of the hereditary Tokugawa retainers, who believed that Ieyasu's settlement was excessively lenient and grossly unfair. Had Osaka appreciated Ieyasu's goodwill, it would not have forgotten the immense favor shown after the Battle of Sekigahara and raised this rebellion.

units.source_en: The daimyos had only just ceased confronting Osaka, and their hearts remained filled with fierce hostility; a great many of them wanted to take part in the filling work.
units.source_zh: 大名们刚刚还与大坂对峙，他们内心只有强烈的敌意，偌多人都想参与填埋工事。

units.source_en: Then came the calculations of the hereditary Tokugawa retainers, who believed that Ieyasu's settlement was excessively lenient and grossly unfair.
units.source_zh: 接下来就是德川谱代的算计了，他们认为，家康这次处置过分温和，甚是不公。

units.source_en: Had Osaka appreciated Ieyasu's goodwill, it would not have forgotten the immense favor shown after the Battle of Sekigahara and raised this rebellion.

ja.t: こすことなどなかったはずだ。

units.source_zh: 大坂若能体谅家康的情义，便不会忘掉关原合战后的大恩，发动乱事。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大名们刚刚还与大坂对峙，他们内心只有强烈的敌意，偌多人都想参与填埋工事。接下来就是德川谱代的算计了，他们认为，家康这次处置过分温和，甚是不公。大坂若能体谅家康的情义，便不会忘掉关原合战后的大恩，发动乱事。

paragraphs.source_en: As Ieyasu withdrew to Nijō Castle, work on filling the moats began in full force. With the year-end fast approaching, and the lower-ranking warriors and laborers engaged in the work longing to return home, the project advanced rapidly. Before their eyes, the barbicans were torn open, and earthen ramparts and watchtowers vanished from the ground. At the intake from the Yodo River, laborers with only scraps of cloth wrapped around their loins built up a cofferdam while raising earth-shaking work chants in the frigid wind.

units.source_en: As Ieyasu withdrew to Nijō Castle, work on filling the moats began in full force.
units.source_zh: 家康撤回二条城的同时，填埋护城河的工程也正热火朝天展开。

units.source_en: With the year-end fast approaching, and the lower-ranking warriors and laborers engaged in the work longing to return home, the project advanced rapidly.
units.source_zh: 由于年关将至，加之参加填埋的下级武士和人夫归乡心切，工程进展迅速。

units.source_en: Before their eyes, the barbicans were torn open, and earthen ramparts and watchtowers vanished from the ground.
units.source_zh: 眼见着瓮城被掘开，土堤和箭楼从地面消失。

units.source_en: At the intake from the Yodo River, laborers with only scraps of cloth wrapped around their loins built up a cofferdam while raising earth-shaking work chants in the frigid wind.
units.source_zh: 淀川的取水口处，下身只裹布片的人夫们一面在寒风中喊出震天的号子，一面堆起堰堤。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康撤回二条城的同时，填埋护城河的工程也正热火朝天展开。由于年关将至，加之参加填埋的下级武士和人夫归乡心切，工程进展迅速。眼见着瓮城被掘开，土堤和箭楼从地面消失。淀川的取水口处，下身只裹布片的人夫们一面在寒风中喊出震天的号子，一面堆起堰堤。

paragraphs.source_en: Date Masamune, who had not shed his armor for a long while, changed into a battle surcoat and Iga trousers and, from beneath his conical hat, surveyed the filling work at the Matsuyamachi entrance under his charge.

units.source_en: Date Masamune, who had not shed his armor for a long while, changed into a battle surcoat and Iga trousers and, from beneath his conical hat, surveyed the filling work at the Matsuyamachi entrance under his charge.
units.source_zh: 许久未脱下戎装的伊达政宗换上阵羽织和伊贺袴，从斗笠下眺望着他负责的松屋町口的填埋工程。

paragraphs.source_zh: 许久未脱下戎装的伊达政宗换上阵羽织和伊贺袴，从斗笠下眺望着他负责的松屋町口的填埋工程。

paragraphs.source_en: A chill ran down Masamune's back: he should have ordered Hasekura Rokuemon never to return to Japan if the enterprise failed!

units.source_en: A chill ran down Masamune's back: he should have ordered Hasekura Rokuemon never to return to Japan if the enterprise failed!
units.source_zh: 政宗后背冒出一股凉气：早当命令支仓六右卫门，一旦事情不成，就休再回日本！

paragraphs.source_zh: 政宗后背冒出一股凉气：早当命令支仓六右卫门，一旦事情不成，就休再回日本！

paragraphs.source_en: If Rokuemon returned in triumph yet brought back only a single warship, Masamune would be forced to sink it with his own hand and strike Rokuemon down in fury. For then, he would have to place the entire coastline of Japan under guard.

units.source_en: If Rokuemon returned in triumph yet brought back only a single warship, Masamune would be forced to sink it with his own hand and strike Rokuemon down in fury.

ja.t: だけだったなら、そのとき

units.source_zh: 若六右卫门得意扬扬地回来了，却只带来一艘兵船，到时，政宗就不得不亲自把它击沉，怒斩六右卫门。

units.source_en: For then, he would have to place the entire coastline of Japan under guard.

ja.t: かねばならなくなるからだ。

units.source_zh: 因为那时，他必须在全日本的海滨都安排警戒。

paragraphs.source_zh: 若六右卫门得意扬扬地回来了，却只带来一艘兵船，到时，政宗就不得不亲自把它击沉，怒斩六右卫门。因为那时，他必须在全日本的海滨都安排警戒。

paragraphs.source_en: Standing beside the moat as it was steadily filled, Masamune stared blankly at the water, burdened by immense unease. A lone wild duck flapped past his shoulder and settled upon a stretch of water not yet filled in.

units.source_en: Standing beside the moat as it was steadily filled, Masamune stared blankly at the water, burdened by immense unease.
units.source_zh: 政宗伫立在不断被填埋的护城河边，怀着巨大的不安，呆呆凝视着水面。

units.source_en: A lone wild duck flapped past his shoulder and settled upon a stretch of water not yet filled in.
units.source_zh: 一只离群的野鸭扑腾着翅膀掠过他肩头，落在尚未填平的水面。

paragraphs.source_zh: 政宗伫立在不断被填埋的护城河边，怀着巨大的不安，呆呆凝视着水面。一只离群的野鸭扑腾着翅膀掠过他肩头，落在尚未填平的水面。

paragraphs.source_en: “Lord Mutsu-no-kami—no, I should call you the Lord of Sendai.” A voice suddenly sounded behind him.

units.source_en: “Lord Mutsu-no-kami—no, I should call you the Lord of Sendai.”
units.source_zh: “陆奥守大人，哦不，当称仙台侯才是。”

units.source_en: A voice suddenly sounded behind him.
units.source_zh: 一个声音突然在他身后响起。

paragraphs.source_zh: “陆奥守大人，哦不，当称仙台侯才是。”一个声音突然在他身后响起。
